blocks.text: The Security Insights dashboard provides customizable widgets that display important information about the assets, VLANs, gateways, and devices in your organization to give you a real-time overview of your organization's security operations.
From the navigation menu, go to Zero Trust Branch > Dashboard > Insights to do the following:

blocks.item: View predefined widgets that show a summary of information about an aspect of your security profile and link to pages with more detailed information.
Refresh the data shown in the dashboard by clicking Refresh.
Access a menu that lets you save the current view as the default, or revert to the default view.
View and edit customized widgets.
View tasks that require your action.

blocks.text: There are two predefined widgets at the top of the dashboard that provide links to other areas of the Zscaler Admin Console:

blocks.item: Assets
The Assets widget shows the total number of assets in your organization. Click Learn more to view more details on the Assets page. To learn more, see Managing Your Assets.
Sites
The Sites widget shows the total number of sites in your organization. Click Learn more to view more details on the Sites page. To learn more, see Managing Sites.

blocks.text: You can customize the Insights dashboard to display graphs most helpful to you in keeping your organization secure. By default, the dashboard shows the following five graphs with commonly analyzed data:

blocks.item: Devices by Brand shows all devices in your organization in a bar chart, organized by category (e.g., VMware).
IoT by Brand shows all Internet of Things devices in a bar chart, organized by model (e.g., Roomba).
Devices by Brand shows all manufacturing equipment in a pie chart, organized by equipment brand (e.g., Hewlett-Packard).
by Network shows all network equipment in a pie chart, organized by equipment type (e.g., access points).
by Site shows all sites in a pie chart.
by Protection shows all sites by protected or unprotected.

blocks.text: You can customize any or all of these widgets to show information in a different chart type or to display different information types. To modify a dashboard widget:

blocks.item: Hover over a widget to make the Edit icon appear.
Click the Edit icon.
Modify the fields to display the information you want:

Title: The widget's name. To bold any text, surround the text with (e.g., Title). Hover over ? to see a list of variables you can add to the description (e.g., $groupBy displays the field used to group the chart).

Description: (Optional) A description of the widget. To bold any text, surround the text with (e.g., Title). Hover over ? to see a list of variables you can add to the description (e.g., $groupBy displays the field used to group the chart).
Chart Type: Choose from pie or bar.

TopN: The maximum number of categories to display, starting with the most populated categories. (Optional) Select the Include Null values checkbox if you want to include devices that aren't categorized.
Group by: Choose from Assignment type, Brand, Capability, Category, Group, Location, Model, Network, etc.
Filter by Category: Choose a category.
Filter by Type: Choose a type.
